# KOVA reel scripts

## REEL-01 — One tee, three plans

15 seconds

Hook: One tee. Three plans.

- 0–3s: front-on tee shot with the hook overlay.
- 3–7s: denim and trainers, labelled coffee.
- 7–11s: relaxed trousers and a tote, labelled class.
- 11–15s: open shirt layer, labelled evening walk.

Voiceover: One starting point, a few different plans. Find your everyday with KOVA.

CTA: Explore the first-drop preview.

Storyboard and script only. No filmed reel or licensed audio is included.

## REEL-02 — Same size, different shape

20 seconds

Hook: Oversized does not mean guessing your size.

- 0–4s: split-screen silhouette comparison.
- 4–9s: show shoulder placement with a simple guide.
- 9–14s: compare sleeve and body width.
- 14–20s: point to a verified size chart before buying.

Voiceover: Start with the fit. Compare a tee you own, then check garment measurements. A size label alone cannot tell the whole story.

CTA: Read the fit guide.

Script only. Real fit claims need measured samples before filming.

## REEL-03 — Three shades, one wardrobe

15 seconds

Hook: Ink. Chalk. Sage. Which one are you?

- 0–4s: folded colour flat-lay.
- 4–8s: Ink paired with stone trousers.
- 8–11s: Chalk paired with denim.
- 11–15s: Sage paired with charcoal, then a colour poll.

Voiceover: A quiet palette, a few familiar combinations. Start with the shade you will actually reach for.

CTA: Choose your shade in the preview.

Storyboard and script only. AI concept images are not filmed product footage.
